title: A middle stone age worked bone industry from Katanda, Upper Semliki Valley, Zaire
version: Science 268(5210), pp. 553–556, DOI 10.1126/science.7725100, original abstract via PubMed.
lineage: Primary excavation synthesis of three Katanda sites. Its approximate age is part of the original excavators' interpretation. Brooks et al. (1995) is a companion dating report for the same sites, and later assessments retain a broader chronology.

passages.note: Reports both barbed and unbarbed worked bone points in a Middle Stone Age context and fish remains at Katanda. The authors propose an age around 90,000 years or older. The abstract does not resolve specimen-level dates, preserved attachments or use.

file.method: Short attributed paraphrases of the inspected passages. No original article bytes are retained.
